verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission uses the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'A towering orange-and-white NASA rocket...'; R2: 'Perched atop the 322-foot-tall (98-meter) Space Launch System rocket'; R3: 'NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket'; R4: 'The Artemis II Space Launch System (SLS) rocket'; R5: 'NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket'; R6: 'Space Launch System rocket'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state that Artemis II uses the SLS rocket.

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket stands 322 feet (98 meters) tall when fully stacked with the Orion spacecraft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lifted upward the 322-foot-tall rocket'; R2: '322-foot-tall (98-meter) Space Launch System rocket'; R4: 'SLS rocket and Orion capsule, when fully stacked, stand 322 feet tall'; R5: 'SLS stands 322 feet (98 m) tall'; R6: '322-foot (98.27-meter) tall'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the stacked SLS with Orion is 322 feet (98 m) tall.

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket fully stacked with the Orion spacecraft is taller than the Statue of Liberty.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'stand 322 feet tall. This makes it taller than the Statue of Liberty'
verifications.reasoning: R4 directly compares the stacked SLS-Orion height to the Statue of Liberty, stating it is taller.

verifications.claim: The total height is 322 feet (98.1--98.3 m).
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.reasoning: References support ~322 ft / 98 m, with R6 specifying 98.27 m within the range, but no exact 98.1-98.3 m range stated.

verifications.claim: The SLS rocket itself, including boosters, is ~322 ft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '322-foot-tall rocket'; R2: '322-foot-tall... Space Launch System rocket'; R3: '98m (322ft)... SLS rocket'; R5: 'SLS stands 322 feet (98 m) tall'; R6: '322-foot... Space Launch System rocket'
verifications.reasoning: References describe the SLS (including boosters) stacked height as ~322 ft; approximate match.

verifications.claim: The SLS rocket is about 7 feet taller than London's Big Ben.

verifications.evidence: R3: 'NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket stands 2m (7ft) taller than the famous clock tower'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly states SLS is 2m (7ft) taller than Big Ben.
